description: This file contains utility functions for theme management in a UI project, including theme color variants, font sizes, and dark mode detection.

methods.name: getFontSize
methods.description: Retrieves font size from theme tokens based on a size key.

methods.name: isThemeDark
methods.description: Determines if the current theme is dark mode based on background color.

methods.name: getColorVariants
methods.description: Generates color variants for a given color type from theme tokens, with special handling for default and grayscale colors.

methods.name: isThemeConfigDark
methods.description: Checks if a theme configuration results in a dark theme.

methods.name: useThemeMode
methods.description: React hook to determine if the current theme is dark mode.
